San Antonio's biggest Diwali nightlife celebration, inside the newly renovated 1902 Venue in St. Paul Square. Bollywood classics, Punjabi anthems, hip-hop and house all night, the night before DiwaliSA at Hemisfair.

Lineup: DJ Alx Spins, DJ JANAM, MC SAWI, and David Sharma on live dhol.

Friday, November 6, 2026, 9 PM to 2 AM. 18+ with valid ID. Tickets $60 to $2,500 (GA, GA+, VIP, floor tables for 8, and a private section for 10). Group deal: Squad 4-Pack, 4 GA tickets for $204.
